required_documents.name: Research Strategy
required_documents.details: Project narrative detailing scientific background, specific aims, significance, innovation, and experimental approach.

required_documents.name: Research Plan and Specific Aims
required_documents.details: One-page statement describing broad long-term objectives and goals.

required_documents.name: Budget Justification
required_documents.details: Itemized budget justification reflecting the actual personnel and operational needs of the proposed project.

required_documents.name: Biographical Sketches
required_documents.details: Senior/key personnel biographical sketches with personal statements.

required_documents.name: Letters of Support
required_documents.details: Letters demonstrating institutional commitment and partner collaboration.

required_documents.name: Data Management and Sharing Plan
required_documents.details: Plan outlining data sharing procedures and genomic data sharing if applicable.

eligibility.summary: Other Eligible Applicants include the following: Alaska Native and Native Hawaiian Serving Institutions; Asian American Native American Pacific Islander Serving Institutions (AANAPISISs); Eligible Agencies of the Federal Government; Faith-based or Community-based Organizations; Hispanic-serving Institutions; Historically Black Colleges and Universi In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity RFA-ES-25-002.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
